label: Readiness/maturity grade
description: Current maturity state for a named service floor under a named loadcase.

label: Owner assignment complete
description: Executive, operational, ledger, finance, redress, and backup/succession owners are named.

label: Evidence freshness class
description: Whether the evidence supporting the service-floor claim is current enough to rely on.

label: Excluded-user path passed
description: Whether a non-default, protected, low-access, or otherwise excluded user path has been tested.

label: Degraded mode tested
description: Whether reduced service works under outage/displacement/staffing/cyber/hazard load.

label: Corrective-action closure rate
description: Share of material findings closed with evidence and retest.

label: Civil-rights access pass rate
description: Share of required language/disability/no-digital/no-ID paths that pass.

label: Control test passed
description: Whether required control evidence passed review.

label: Contract milestone delivery status
description: Delivery status for procurement/grant/contracting processes linked to resilience service floors.

label: Workforce role depth
description: Depth of trained/credentialed staffing for required service-floor roles.
